inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names silent (mouthed, silently articulated or unvoiced) speech, sentence-level or open- or large-vocabulary material, and a word error rate, with any signal (EMG, ultrasound, video, EEG, intracranial, acoustic sensing); the design compared is the recording signal and whether the corpus comes from a single speaker, counted by full-text pattern.
